node.title: Re: Extending a perl program with Scheme, Lua, or JS
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
There is [mod://Inline::Lua], although JS is probably more popular nowadays. In that vein, there is [mod://JavaScript::V8], [mod://JavaScript::Duktape], or even the pure-Perl [mod://JE], which is available in Debian as [https://packages.debian.org/stretch/libje-perl|libje-perl].

Update:

use warnings; use strict; use JE; my $j = new JE; $j->eval(<<'MYJSCODE'); function foo (x) { return x / 10; } MYJSCODE my $rv = 0+$j->{foo}->(50); print "$rv\n"; # prints "5"
